name: persona_enact
description: Enacts a persona's cognitive stance and active inference policy over memory under Dual-Process appraisal dynamics (ADR-0032).

problem.description: Problem context or situation to appraise and react to

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.

acting_soul_id.description: ID or handle of the persona to enact (e.g. 'jarvis', 'forge', 'atlas')

mode.description: Enactment mode: REACT, DECIDE, SIMULATE, REPLAY. Defaults to REACT.

as_of.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for temporal counterfactual replay
